page_title: HOL 1-3 HOF | Holstein Kiel v Hoffenheim 18/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' That's it for today, Sven Jablonski has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+8' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) receives the ball from the resulting free kick and unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
90+8' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) commits a rough challenge and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Holstein Kiel.
90+6' Wonderful movement by Holstein Kiel. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
90+5' The ball is cleared after Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+2' The referee allows time for a substitution. Max Moerstedt will be replaced by Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim).
90+1' We will have 11 min. of added time.
88' Corner kicks – 4:3.
87' Problems for Christian Ilzer as Erencan Yardimci is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and David Mokwa Ntusu (Hoffenheim) replaces him.
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Alexander Bernhardsson walks off the pitch to be replaced by Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel).
87' Timon Weiner (Holstein Kiel) has received a yellow card for his foul.
86' Erencan Yardimci (Hoffenheim) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

84' 1 - 3 Dominik Javorcek sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Andu Yobel Kelati (Holstein Kiel) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:3.

83' Close! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Holstein Kiel will have a goal kick.
81' The corner is swung in but Holstein Kiel can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

80' Excellent touch by Andu Yobel Kelati (Holstein Kiel)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save. Holstein Kiel force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
78' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) sends a chip pass into the box, but Oliver Baumann is quickest to intercept the ball.
76' Timon Weiner pulls off a great save to deny Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the top of the net.
75' Andu Yobel Kelati (Holstein Kiel) sends a cross into the box, but Oliver Baumann comes off his line to gather the ball.

75' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Holstein Kiel are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
73' Here is a change. David Zec is going off and Marcel Rapp gives the last tactical orders to Dominik Javorcek (Holstein Kiel).
70' Looks like we are going to have a change of refs with Sven Jablonski taking over.
70' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Anton Stach leaves the pitch to be replaced by Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim).
68' 48:52 – the ratio of ball possession.
65' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
64' Max Geschwill (Holstein Kiel) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Oliver Baumann, who smothers the ball.
61' The substitution is prepared. Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Magnus Knudsen.
61' Marcel Rapp prepares a substitution. Shuto Machino is replaced by Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel).
61' Substitution. Andu Yobel Kelati (Holstein Kiel) in, Lasse Rosenboom out.
59' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
56' 0 - 3 Goal! Tom Bischof tees up Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the left side of the goal. 0:3.
54' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

54' Hoffenheim show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
53' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel).
51' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

49' What a chance that is! Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
47' Holstein Kiel are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
47' Felix Brych blows for a foul after Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Felix Brych has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Hoffenheim players have a reason to celebrate!
45+3' Wait! Referee Felix Brych has indicated he is going to review the Hoffenheim goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

45+1' 0 - 2 Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Timon Weiner is just a bystander as the ball flies into the right side of the goal. The score is 0:2.
45+1' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' David Zec (Holstein Kiel) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
41' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.
39' Lasse Rosenboom (Holstein Kiel) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' Holstein Kiel fail to score from a corner as Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim) leaps to collect the ball.

37' Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. It will be a corner kick for Holstein Kiel.
35' Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
33' 1:5 – the total goal attempt statistics. 0:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
31' Erencan Yardimci (Hoffenheim) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
29' Hoffenheim are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
26' 0 - 1 Goal! Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
23' Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Felix Brych didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
20' Holstein Kiel take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
18' Corner kick. Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) is ready to send the ball into the box.
18' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Holstein Kiel will have a chance to score from a corner.
17' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Holstein Kiel will have a goal kick.
15' Erencan Yardimci (Hoffenheim) commits a foul and Felix Brych immediately signals a free kick.
12' Marko Ivezic (Holstein Kiel) tackles a bit over-zealously and Felix Brych blows for a foul. Hoffenheim decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
11' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Holstein Kiel.
8' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is behind the touchline and Holstein Kiel will take a throw-in.
6' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) hits a volley towards goal, but the ball flies straight at the goalkeeper.
5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hoffenheim comes to nothing.

5' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
4' Hoffenheim seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
2' A quickly taken corner by Hoffenheim.
2' Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball goes out of play. Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.
1' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Erencan Yardimci (Hoffenheim) heads on.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Hoffenheim will take the kick-off.
Felix Brych will supervise the game today.
